title: How to Buy USDT - Step-by-Step Guide

cues.text: Welcome! In this short video, you'll learn how to buy USDT, step by step.
It only takes a few minutes, and we'll show you how to stay safe along the way.
First, what is USDT? USDT, also known as Tether, is a stablecoin.
Its value is designed to stay close to one US dollar, so its price doesn't jump up and down like Bitcoin.
That's why people use it to save, send money, and trade.
Before you start, make sure you have three things.
A smartphone or a computer,
a valid ID, such as a passport or a national ID card,
and a payment method, like a bank card or a bank account.
Step one: choose a trusted exchange that is licensed and available in your country.
Download its official app, or type the website address carefully, because fake copies do exist.
Tap Sign up, enter your email address, and create a strong, unique password.
Then confirm with the code sent to your email.
Step two: protect your account. Open Security settings and turn on two-factor authentication.
With an authenticator app, every login needs a fresh six-digit code from your phone.
So even if someone steals your password, they can't get in.
Step three: verify your identity. This is called KYC, and most regulated exchanges require it.
Take a clear photo of your ID, then a quick selfie, to prove it's really you.
Approval can take from a few minutes up to a day.
Step four: add money to your account. Tap Deposit and choose your local currency.
Select a payment method, such as a bank transfer or a card, enter the amount, and confirm.
Always check the fees and the final amount before you pay.
Step five: buy USDT. Go to Buy, and search for USDT.
Enter how much you want to spend. The app shows how much USDT you'll get, including fees.
Check the details, tap Buy USDT, and confirm.
Done! Your USDT now appears in your wallet balance.
Step six is optional: sending USDT to another wallet.
Tap Withdraw, choose USDT, and paste the receiving address. Never type it by hand.
Now the most important part: choose the correct network, for example TRC-20, ERC-20, or BEP-20.
It must match the network of the receiving wallet. If it doesn't, your funds can be lost forever.
Tip: send a small test amount first, and once it arrives, send the rest.
Finally, some golden safety rules.
Never share your password, your two-factor codes, or your recovery phrase with anyone. Real support staff will never ask for them.
Ignore anyone who promises guaranteed profits. It's almost always a scam.
And always double-check the address and the network before you confirm.
Let's recap.
Choose a trusted exchange, secure your account, verify your identity, add funds, buy USDT, and withdraw carefully.
That's it! You're ready to buy your first USDT. Thanks for watching!
